caption:
Every breakfast is included on our expeditions, and none of them comes from a buffet.

In the mountain lodges, the day opens with rice and beans, eggs, plantain, tortillas, and coffee from the valley. On Day 4 of the trail running week, you descend 2,351 metres from Providencia into San Isidro de Dota. It is a self-supported 25-kilometre stage. There are no support vans along the river. Instead, mountain families open their doors with coffee, agua dulce, fruit, and warm empanadas.

We travel in groups of 6 to 8 athletes. Every meal has an origin and someone who made it.

The Trail Running Expedition. 5 – 13 December 2026, 20 – 28 February 2027, 7 – 15 August 2027. Details in the bio.
